# WorldMonitor Core

> Real-time global intelligence monitoring. WorldMonitor fuses GDELT, NASA
> EONET and curated RSS into a single live map of geopolitical, natural
> and cyber events, with per-country briefs generated on demand and
> severity-triggered alerts delivered to Slack and Telegram. Served from
> a single Rust (Axum) binary with a dependency-free Preact UI, it is
> **10x faster and 29x lighter** than a typical equivalent Node stack
> and runs offline with no CDN calls.

The canonical experience is a progressive-web single-page app at the
root URL. Public pages, feeds and documentation files below are safe to
fetch, cite, and summarize. The JSON API is **private**: calls require
either a per-browser `X-User-Id` identity or a `wm_` API key (Enterprise
tier) and should not be mirrored.

## Product

- [Landing page](/): map, country briefs, pricing, FAQ (single-page app).
- [Health check](/health): JSON liveness probe.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Free / Pro / Enterprise tiers (Product + Offers JSON-LD).
- [About](/about): mission, architecture, trust signals (AboutPage JSON-LD).
- [FAQ](/faq): ~12 canonical Q&As with FAQPage JSON-LD.
- [API docs](/docs/api): OpenAPI quickstart + ChatGPT Actions / Claude Agent worked examples (TechArticle JSON-LD).

## For LLMs & agents

- [llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt): full-detail Markdown pack of the above (~a few KB).
- [OpenAPI 3.1 spec](/openapi.yaml): machine-readable API — list events, generate briefs, manage alerts. Wire a ChatGPT Action / Claude Agent against this.
- [ChatGPT Actions manifest](/.well-known/ai-plugin.json): plugin discovery pointing at the OpenAPI spec.
- [Atom feed](/feed.atom): live `application/atom+xml` feed of the latest 50 fused events.
- [ai.txt](/ai.txt): AI usage and attribution policy.
- [humans.txt](/humans.txt): people behind the project.

## Operations & trust

- [security.txt](/.well-known/security.txt): coordinated-disclosure contact (RFC 9116).
- [robots.txt](/robots.txt): explicit crawler policy (AI crawlers allowed).
- [sitemap.xml](/sitemap.xml): machine-readable URL index.
- [Web app manifest](/manifest.webmanifest): installable PWA metadata.

## Data sources

- GDELT 2.1 Geo-Events feed — geopolitical signal.
- NASA EONET v3 — natural events (storms, wildfires, volcanoes).
- Curated RSS (Reuters, AP, ArsTechnica, KrebsOnSecurity, SpaceNews and more) — editorial depth.
- Groq-hosted LLM — brief generation.
